figurative_meaning_en: Running at high speed or fleeing
example_sentences_in_bangla: ভয় পেয়ে সে সাঁই সাঁই করে দৌড় দিল।
পুলিশ দেখে চোর সাঁই সাঁই করে পালাল।
example_sentences_in_english: Terrified, he ran off with a whistling speed.
Seeing the police, the thief fled at breakneck speed.
note: Onomatopoeic expression mimicking the sound of rapid movement
